record.question: Which of the following patients does not have a risk factor for hypertension?
options: A 25 year old male with a BMI of 35.
A 35 year old female with a total cholesterol level of 100.
A 68 year old male who reports smoking 2 packs of cigarettes a day.
A 40 year old female with a family history of hypertension and diabetes.
record.explanation: Answer B: A 35 year old female with a total cholesterol level of 100.. A 35-year-old with total cholesterol of 100 mg/dL has no listed hypertension risk factor; obesity, smoking, older age, and family history are risk indicators. Source/context note: Hypertension risk is multifactorial; cholesterol is a cardiovascular risk factor but not a direct defining hypertension risk factor. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/high-blood-pressure/risk-factors/index.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
